raw_response:
This land no be my own, na rent I rent am, so I no go waste my small money put plenty fertilizer inside. I dey plant cassava and small yam like my papa teach me — local stem cutting from last year harvest, no need to buy new one. I go cut bush, make heap, plant, weed two times with my cutlass. If I get small money I fit buy one bag NPK share am with my brother, but most time I just depend on the soil and small ash from cooking fire.
